source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Whenever a **DAMNED** unit of yours that has [Dark Pacts](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts) is picked to make a **Normal move**, an **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or a charge declaration, it may make a Desperate Pact. A unit that came in from Reserves this turn cannot.

To make a Desperate Pact:

1. The unit takes a Leadership test; on a fail, it takes D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)**.
2. For the rest of the phase, its models get +2" Move and the unit adds 2 to its **Charge rolls**.
